    Sixmile Creek example stream network

    sixmile_creek_stream_reaches.Rd

    Stream-flowline geometry for Sixmile Creek and its tributary Dorn Creek near Waunakee, Wisconsin. The network surrounds the hypothetical pumping-well location used in the `streamDepletr` introductory example.

    data(sixmile_creek_stream_reaches)

    Format

    An `sf` object with one row per USGS 3D Hydrography Program flowline and the following fields:

    reach_id

    Character 3DHP flowline identifier.

    stream_name

    Character stream name: `"Sixmile Creek"` or `"Dorn Creek"`.

    geometry

    `MULTILINESTRING` geometry in NAD83 / UTM zone 16N (EPSG:26916).

    Source

    U.S. Geological Survey 3D Hydrography Program, https://www.usgs.gov/3d-hydrography-program/access-3dhp-data-products

    Details

    The data are generated by `data-raw/sixmile-creek-stream-reaches.R` using [get_usgs_stream_reaches()]. The script queries all 3DHP flowlines within 10 kilometers of the example well at easting 295500 meters and northing 4783200 meters, then retains flowlines named Sixmile Creek or Dorn Creek. Because this object is a snapshot of the USGS service, rerunning the script after a hydrography update may produce different geometry or identifiers.
